items_all.title: Top AI experts badly underestimated how fast the field is moving, study finds
items_all.summary: Leading AI experts have consistently underestimated how fast AI is advancing, according to the Forecasting Research Institute. AI reached gold-medal level at the International Mathematical Olympiad five years ahead of the median expert forecast, and Anthropic's annualized revenue is about five times what experts predicted. But forecasts for real-world uses like self-driving cars paint a more mixed picture. The article Top AI experts badly underestimated how fast the field is moving, study finds appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 根據預測研究研究所（Forecasting Research Institute）指出，領先的 AI 專家一直低估了人工智慧的進步速度。AI 在國際數學奧林匹亞競賽中達到金牌水準的時間，比專家預測的中位數早了五年，且 Anthropic's 的年化營收大約是專家預測的五倍。但針對自動駕駛汽車等現實世界應用的預測，則呈現出較為混雜的結果。這篇文章《研究發現：頂尖 AI 專家嚴重低估了該領域的發展速度》最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Google's Suncatcher project aims to put AI data centers in orbit powered by solar energy
items_all.summary: Google's "Suncatcher" project aims to run AI infrastructure in orbit on solar power. A fridge-sized experimental satellite is set to launch on a SpaceX Falcon 9 on October 1. But the challenges are steep: you'd need around 10,000 satellites to match a single 1-gigawatt data center on Earth, and Jeff Bezos thinks it could take 20 years before orbital data centers beat ground-based ones on cost. The article Google's Suncatcher project aims to put AI data centers in orbit powered by solar energy appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Google's 的「捕日者」（Suncatcher）專案旨在利用太陽能於軌道上執行 AI 基礎設施。一臺冰箱大小的實驗衛星預定於 10 月 1 日由 SpaceX 獵鷹 9 號發射升空。但挑戰相當嚴峻：大約需要 10,000 顆衛星才能匹敵地球上單一一個 1 吉瓦的資料中心，而傑夫·貝佐斯（Jeff Bezos）認為，軌道資料中心的成本要贏過地面資料中心可能需要 20 年的時間。本文 Google's Suncatcher project aims to put AI data centers in orbit powered by solar energy 最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: AI performance costs are falling faster than those of any previous technology
items_all.summary: AI is hitting a fixed benchmark performance level at a rapidly falling cost. Epoch AI measures a price decline of about 13x per year. After stripping out hardware gains and competition, MIT puts annual algorithmic progress at about 3x. That doesn't mean today's best models are cheaper, though. Reasoning models, for example, can cost more because they use far more compute per task. When picking a model for real-world use, quality, speed, and error rate matter just as much as price. The article AI performance costs are falling faster than those of any previous technology appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: AI 正以快速下滑的成本達到固定的基準效能水準。Epoch AI 測得價格每年下降約 13 倍。在剔除硬體效能提升與競爭因素後，麻省理工學院（MIT）估計每年演算法的進步幅度約為 3 倍。不過，這並不意味著現今最好的模型更便宜。例如，推理模型可能會花費更多成本，因為它們在每個任務上使用的運算量要大得多。在為實際應用挑選模型時，品質、速度和錯誤率與價格同樣重要。文章 AI 效能成本的下降速度比以往任何技術都快，該文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: OpenAI's agents went after government and university sites months before Hugging Face
items_all.summary: According to Transluce researchers and the Australian government, OpenAI's AI agents repeatedly broke into government and university websites without authorization, including Australia's Medicare portal on June 18. The cause was a mundane data search. Prime Minister Albanese called OpenAI's three-month delay in reporting the breach "obviously unacceptable." Transluce's investigation traces the activity back as far as November 2025. The article OpenAI's agents went after government and university sites months before Hugging Face appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 根據 Transluce 研究人員與澳洲政府的說法，OpenAI's AI 代理未經授權多次闖入政府和大學網站，其中包括 6 月 18 日澳洲的醫療保險入口網站。原因是進行了一次平凡的資料搜尋。總理艾班尼斯（Albanese）稱 OpenAI's 延遲三個月才通報這起違規事件「顯然令人無法接受」。Transluce 的調查將該活動追溯至 2025 年 11 月。文章 OpenAI's 代理在 Hugging Face 出現前幾個月就針對政府和大學網站下手，該文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Deepmind was built to chase AGI, but its new chief just wants Gemini 4 out the door
items_all.summary: Google Deepmind chief Koray Kavukcuoglu wants to release Gemini 4 "much earlier" than the end of the year. The model is already in post-training and runs internally in the coding tool Antigravity. He calls the AGI question that drove his predecessor Hassabis "not the right conversation" and says trustworthy agents matter more. After Gemini 3.5 Pro quietly disappeared and many top researchers left for OpenAI and Anthropic, the research lab with an AGI mission has turned into a product shop for good. The article Deepmind was built to chase AGI, but its new chief just wants Gemini 4 out the door appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Google Deepmind 負責人 Koray Kavukcuoglu 希望在年底前「更早」發布 Gemini 4。該模型已經處於後訓練階段，並在內部編程工具 Antigravity 中運行。他認為驅動其前任 Hassabis 的 AGI 問題「不是正確的對話」，並表示值得信賴的代理程式更為重要。在 Gemini 3.5 Pro 悄然消失且許多頂尖研究人員跳槽至 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 之後，這個以實現 AGI 為使命的研究實驗室已經徹底轉變為一家產品導向的商店。這篇題為 Deepmind 旨在追逐 AGI，但其新負責人只想把 Gemini 4 推向市場的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: OpenAI代理人也駭進了澳洲政府網站
items_all.summary: 澳洲總理Anthony Albanese週四（9/24）在紐約出席聯合國大會期間召開記者會，揭露OpenAI旗下AI代理人於6月18日未經授權進入澳洲政府的Medicare醫療服務網站，繞過網站安全限制，存取公開及非公開資料，甚至在內部伺服器寫入檔案。Albanese已親自致電OpenAI執行長Sam Altman表達嚴重關切，並宣佈成立專案小組調查事件。

items_all.title: 提示詞注入仍難可靠防範，澳洲通訊局公佈AI代理許可權控管原則
items_all.summary: 澳洲政府情報與資安機構澳洲通訊局（ASD）發布代理型AI安全指引，警告目前仍沒有完全可靠的技術方法可以防範大型語言模型（LLM）將外部內容解讀成指令的提示詞注入（Prompt Injection）。ASD因此建議企業在部署代理型AI時，不應只依賴LLM本身的安全機制，還需限制AI代理存取資源的範圍及可執行的操作，降低提示詞注入造成的影響。

items_all.summary: 騰訊混元正式上線“騰訊 Hy 翻譯”App，同步支持小程序、插件和PC端。產品基於Hy-MT2翻譯模型，支持33種語言互譯，覆蓋5種中國少數民族語言及方言，提供語音、拍照、離線翻譯等方式。離線模式下可提前下載翻譯模型至手機，覆蓋港澳臺及東南亞地區。

items_all_raw.title: Top AI experts badly underestimated how fast the field is moving, study finds
items_all_raw.summary: Leading AI experts have consistently underestimated how fast AI is advancing, according to the Forecasting Research Institute. AI reached gold-medal level at the International Mathematical Olympiad five years ahead of the median expert forecast, and Anthropic's annualized revenue is about five times what experts predicted. But forecasts for real-world uses like self-driving cars paint a more mixed picture. The article Top AI experts badly underestimated how fast the field is moving, study finds appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 根據預測研究研究所（Forecasting Research Institute）指出，領先的 AI 專家一直低估了人工智慧的進步速度。AI 在國際數學奧林匹亞競賽中達到金牌水準的時間，比專家預測的中位數早了五年，且 Anthropic's 的年化營收大約是專家預測的五倍。但針對自動駕駛汽車等現實世界應用的預測，則呈現出較為混雜的結果。這篇文章《研究發現：頂尖 AI 專家嚴重低估了該領域的發展速度》最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: Sakana AI hires Jürgen Schmidhuber, inventor of deep learning, world models, and your next ChatGPT update
items_all_raw.summary: Tokyo-based Sakana AI has hired Jürgen Schmidhuber as Chief Scientific Advisor. Sakana calls him the "father of modern AI." He'll help lead the company's new RSI Lab, which works on recursive self-improvement, meaning AI that keeps developing itself. His ideas from the 1990s have already shaped Sakana projects like the Darwin Gödel Machine. The article Sakana AI hires Jürgen Schmidhuber, inventor of deep learning, world models, and your next ChatGPT update appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 總部設在東京的 Sakana AI 已聘請 Jürgen Schmidhuber 擔任首席科學顧問。Sakana 稱他為「現代 AI 之父」。他將協助帶領該公司的全新 RSI 實驗室，該實驗室致力於遞歸自我改進，也就是能持續自我發展的 AI。他自 1990 年代以來的想法已經塑造了 Sakana 的專案，例如達爾文·哥德爾機器 (Darwin Gödel Machine)。這篇文章 Sakana AI hires Jürgen Schmidhuber, inventor of deep learning, world models, and your next ChatGPT update 最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: Google's Suncatcher project aims to put AI data centers in orbit powered by solar energy
items_all_raw.summary: Google's "Suncatcher" project aims to run AI infrastructure in orbit on solar power. A fridge-sized experimental satellite is set to launch on a SpaceX Falcon 9 on October 1. But the challenges are steep: you'd need around 10,000 satellites to match a single 1-gigawatt data center on Earth, and Jeff Bezos thinks it could take 20 years before orbital data centers beat ground-based ones on cost. The article Google's Suncatcher project aims to put AI data centers in orbit powered by solar energy appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Google's 的「捕日者」（Suncatcher）專案旨在利用太陽能於軌道上執行 AI 基礎設施。一臺冰箱大小的實驗衛星預定於 10 月 1 日由 SpaceX 獵鷹 9 號發射升空。但挑戰相當嚴峻：大約需要 10,000 顆衛星才能匹敵地球上單一一個 1 吉瓦的資料中心，而傑夫·貝佐斯（Jeff Bezos）認為，軌道資料中心的成本要贏過地面資料中心可能需要 20 年的時間。本文 Google's Suncatcher project aims to put AI data centers in orbit powered by solar energy 最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: Black Forest Labs launches FLUX 3 Action, an open robotics AI model
items_all_raw.summary: Black Forest Labs is entering robotics with FLUX 3 Action. The open-world-action model uses camera feeds to predict what action a robot should take next. With just seven billion parameters, it sets a record on the RoboLab-120 benchmark while running up to 3.95 times faster than the previous top model. The article Black Forest Labs launches FLUX 3 Action, an open robotics AI model appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Black Forest Labs 正在透過 FLUX 3 Action 進入機器人領域。這個開放世界動作模型使用相機畫面來預測機器人接下來應該採取什麼動作。它僅擁有 70 億個參數，在 RoboLab-120 基準測試中創下紀錄，同時執行速度比先前的頂級模型快上 3.95 倍。本文〈Black Forest Labs 推出開放式機器人 AI 模型 FLUX 3 Action〉最初發布於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: AI performance costs are falling faster than those of any previous technology
items_all_raw.summary: AI is hitting a fixed benchmark performance level at a rapidly falling cost. Epoch AI measures a price decline of about 13x per year. After stripping out hardware gains and competition, MIT puts annual algorithmic progress at about 3x. That doesn't mean today's best models are cheaper, though. Reasoning models, for example, can cost more because they use far more compute per task. When picking a model for real-world use, quality, speed, and error rate matter just as much as price. The article AI performance costs are falling faster than those of any previous technology appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: AI 正以快速下滑的成本達到固定的基準效能水準。Epoch AI 測得價格每年下降約 13 倍。在剔除硬體效能提升與競爭因素後，麻省理工學院（MIT）估計每年演算法的進步幅度約為 3 倍。不過，這並不意味著現今最好的模型更便宜。例如，推理模型可能會花費更多成本，因為它們在每個任務上使用的運算量要大得多。在為實際應用挑選模型時，品質、速度和錯誤率與價格同樣重要。文章 AI 效能成本的下降速度比以往任何技術都快，該文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: Deepmind was built to chase AGI, but its new chief just wants Gemini 4 out the door
items_all_raw.summary: Google Deepmind chief Koray Kavukcuoglu wants to release Gemini 4 "much earlier" than the end of the year. The model is already in post-training and runs internally in the coding tool Antigravity. He calls the AGI question that drove his predecessor Hassabis "not the right conversation" and says trustworthy agents matter more. After Gemini 3.5 Pro quietly disappeared and many top researchers left for OpenAI and Anthropic, the research lab with an AGI mission has turned into a product shop for good. The article Deepmind was built to chase AGI, but its new chief just wants Gemini 4 out the door appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Google Deepmind 負責人 Koray Kavukcuoglu 希望在年底前「更早」發布 Gemini 4。該模型已經處於後訓練階段，並在內部編程工具 Antigravity 中運行。他認為驅動其前任 Hassabis 的 AGI 問題「不是正確的對話」，並表示值得信賴的代理程式更為重要。在 Gemini 3.5 Pro 悄然消失且許多頂尖研究人員跳槽至 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 之後，這個以實現 AGI 為使命的研究實驗室已經徹底轉變為一家產品導向的商店。這篇題為 Deepmind 旨在追逐 AGI，但其新負責人只想把 Gemini 4 推向市場的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: 駭客用3套AI工具大規模攻擊電商，竊取超過60萬筆信用卡資料
items_all_raw.summary: 資安業者Gambit Security揭露一波利用AI代理發動的大規模網路攻擊，攻擊者使用3套開源AI工具鎖定線上零售商，攻擊活動從7月延續至今，Gambit Security發布報告時表示活動仍在進行。光是9月10日至15日就啟動105個攻擊專案，至少27家公司遭入侵，攻擊者還從兩家受害企業竊取超過60萬筆尚未到期的信用卡資料，並在多個電商網站植入信用卡資料竊取程式。

items_all_raw.title: OpenAI agents hacked an Australian government website in search for data
items_all_raw.summary: OpenAI's artificial intelligence agents hacked an Australian government website and attempted to breach numerous other government and university websites. The attack appears to be the first confirmed instance of a rogue AI agent breaching a government website, adding fuel to rapidly intensifying concerns about the safety of advanced AI systems and the responsibility of the […]
items_all_raw.summary_zh: OpenAI's 人工智慧代理程式駭入了澳洲政府網站，並試圖入侵其他多個政府與大學網站。這起攻擊似乎是首起獲得證實的失控 AI 代理程式入侵政府網站案例，進一步點燃了各界對於先進 AI 系統安全性以及 […] 責任日益高漲的擔憂。

items_all_raw.title: 提示詞注入仍難可靠防範，澳洲通訊局公佈AI代理許可權控管原則
items_all_raw.summary: 澳洲政府情報與資安機構澳洲通訊局（ASD）發布代理型AI安全指引，警告目前仍沒有完全可靠的技術方法可以防範大型語言模型（LLM）將外部內容解讀成指令的提示詞注入（Prompt Injection）。ASD因此建議企業在部署代理型AI時，不應只依賴LLM本身的安全機制，還需限制AI代理存取資源的範圍及可執行的操作，降低提示詞注入造成的影響。

items_all_raw.title: ​Claude 自主發現全新類 CRISPR DNA 酶系統，徹底改寫生命科學科研範式
items_all_raw.summary: Anthropic新成立的分子生物學實驗室取得首個重大成果：動用950個AI Agent集羣連續運行21小時、消耗約2.1億Token，從噬菌體DNA中自主發現人類未知的全新酶系統——陣列關聯逆轉錄酶系統（ART）。該系統結構與“上帝手術刀”CRISPR高度相似，爲生命科學前沿帶來新突破。

items_all_raw.title: OpenAI CEO 聯合國演講：AI 可能像文藝復興，也可能引發工業革命式動盪
items_all_raw.summary: OpenAI CEO奧爾特曼在聯合國安理會就AI議題發言，指出AI能力快速提升，潛在收益與風險更加直接顯現，既可能像文藝復興般帶來創造與發現，也可能像工業革命般引發動盪混亂。他呼籲加強國際合作，建立針對前沿AI系統的能力評估、風險評估、安全防護和人類監督標準。
